# Plan: Webflow Navbar + Footer → Next.js Components

## Source analysis complete

### Banner strip (`.banner-section`)
- `background-color: #082753`
- Full-width, `padding: 10px 5%`
- Content: centered flex row with gap-3
- Left: paragraph text `color: #fff`, `font-size: 14px`, `font-family: Roobert PRO`
- Right: "Join Beta" link — white text, underlined (`beta-link` class)

### Navbar (`.navbar` + `.nav-23-*`)
- `background-color: #fff`, `padding: 6px 1%`, `position: relative`, `z-index: 999999`
- Full-width, no max-width on container
- **Layout** — `.nav-23-container`: `justify-content: space-between`, `display: flex`, `gap: 10px`
- **Left** — `.nav-23-left`: `gap: 40px`, logo 130px wide
- **Center** — `.nav-23-menu` + `.nav-23-links`: gap 2px flex row, contains dropdowns + plain links
- **Right** — `.nav-23-right`: `gap: 12px`, Login button + Schedule Demo button + hamburger

#### Menu text style (`.menu-text`)
- `color: #082753`, `font-size: 16px`, `font-weight: 500`, `font-family: Roobert PRO`

#### Nav links (`.nav-23-link`)
- `color: #000`, `border-radius: 8px`, `padding: 8px 5px`, transparent bg
- Hover: bg stays transparent, color stays #000

#### Dropdown toggle (`.nav-23-dropdown-toggle`)
- `color: #000`, `border-radius: 8px`, `padding: 8px 8px 8px 10px`
- `gap: 4px`, `font-size: 16px`

- Nav head text: `font-weight: 500` (`.text-weight-medium-2 nav-head`)

- Coming soon badge (`.header-comingsoon-badge`): `color: #1890ff`, `background-color: #e6f7ff`, `border: 1px solid #91d5ff`, `border-radius: 4px`, `padding: 3px 6px`, `font-size: 9px`, `font-weight: 700`
- Bottom CTA card (`.mnav-inn`): `background-color: #21cfff12`, `border-radius: 8px`, `margin-top: 5px`, `padding: 12px`, flex column, gap 10px

#### Resources dropdown (`.nav-23-dropdown-card`)
- `background-color: #fff`, `border: 1px solid #dde3e8`, `border-radius: 12px`, `min-width: 190px`, `padding: 8px`
- Links (`.nav-23-dropdown-link`): `color: #082753`, `border-radius: 8px`, `padding: 8px 24px 8px 8px`, `font-size: 16px`, `font-weight: 500`
- Hover: `background-color: #21cfff12`

#### Login button (`.button-secondary-large`)
- `color: #082753`, `border: 1px solid #082753`, `border-radius: 10px`, transparent bg
- `padding: 8px 20px`, `font-size: 13px`, `font-weight: 700`
- Hover: `color: #fff`, `background-color: #082753`

#### Schedule Demo button (`.btn-primary`)
- `color: #fff`, `background-image: url(Group-46729-2.svg), linear-gradient(90deg, #21cfff, #019ae6)`
- `background-position: 93%, 0 0`, `background-repeat: no-repeat, repeat`
- `border-radius: .75rem`, `padding: 8px 3rem 8px 1rem`
- `font-size: 13px`, `font-weight: 700`, `font-family: Roobert PRO`
- Hover: `background-color: #092245`, removes gradient image

#### Mobile hamburger (`.nav-23-menu-button`)
- `color: #fff`, `background-color: #000`, `border-radius: 10px`, `width: 48px`, `height: 48px`
- 3 lines: `.nav-23-menu-line`, `background-color: currentColor`, `border-radius: 4px`, `width: 20px`, `height: 2px`, spaced 4px apart

### Sticky behavior
The header is sticky. The Webflow `.header-sec` is a flex column wrapper containing the banner + navbar. We make the whole `<header>` sticky top-0.

### Footer (`.footer`)
- `background-color: #082753`, `padding: 72px 5% 16px`
- Max-width container: `.container-large-6`, `max-width: 1280px`, auto margins

#### Footer grid (`.footer-grid`)
- CSS grid: `grid-template-columns: .75fr 1.25fr`, `gap: 3rem`
- Left: `.footer-main` → `.footer-newsletter-card`
- Right: `.footer-right`

#### Newsletter card (`.footer-newsletter-card`)
- `background-color: #ffffff4d`, `background-image: radial-gradient(circle, #092854, #092955ab)`
- `border: .5px solid #05bafe61`, `border-radius: 20px`, `padding: 30px`
- `box-shadow: 0 0 50px #0003, inset 0 0 100px #092955`
- Sparkle icon + "Join 500+ Subscribers" eyebrow
- Heading: "Agency Growth Insights Delivered Monthly" with gradient span
- Subtext: `color: #c0dbff`, `font-size: 16px`
- Form: email input + "Get Started" button side by side (input full width, button absolute-positioned inside)
  - Input: `border: 1px solid #edeff3`, `border-radius: 8px`, `min-height: 55px`, `padding: 8px 12px`, `font-size: 14px`
  - Button: gradient bg (`linear-gradient(90deg, #21cfff, #019ae6)`), `color: #fff`, `border-radius: 10px`, `padding: 12px 20px`, `font-size: 16px`, `font-weight: 700`, absolutely positioned at right
- Privacy line: shield icon + "100% privacy guaranteed. Unsubscribe anytime."

#### Footer right (`.footer-right`)
- Gap `2.8rem`, flex column
- Top row (`.footer-heading`): logo left, social icons right, `justify-content: space-between`, `align-items: flex-end`
  - Logo: `f-new.svg`
  - Social icons (`.footer-social-link`): 38×38px, `background-color: #ffffff0d`, `border-radius: 10px`

#### Footer links grid (`.footer-links-grid`)
- CSS grid: `grid-template-columns: .75fr 1.25fr 1fr 1fr`, `gap: 24px`, `row-gap: 56px`
- `border-top: 1px solid #ffffff0d`, `padding-top: 2.8rem`
- Column title (`.footer-title`): `color: #fff`, `font-size: 18px`, `font-weight: 700`
- Links (`.footer-link`): `color: #fffc`, `font-size: 16px`, `line-height: 24px`
- Hover: `color: #fff`
- Coming soon badge (`.coming-soon-badge`): separate element, flex row with link

#### Copyright bar (`.footer-legal-wrapper`)
- `justify-content: center`, `margin-top: 20px`, gap 9px
- `.copyright-outer`: `background-color: #113569`, `border-radius: 10px`, `padding: 4px 15px`, flex row, gap 10px
- Text "Designed with ❤️ from India" + Indian flag SVG (`🇮🇳.svg`, `width: 18px`, `height: 18px`)

---

## Files to modify

### 1. `src/lib/constants/navigation.ts`
Update Solutions children to include all 4 services (Web Dev, UI/UX, Graphic Design, App Dev) with icons and descriptions. Update Resources children to include Blog + Help Center. Keep type compatible.

Need to extend `NavItem` type to allow `description?: string` and `icon?: string` (we'll inline SVGs in navbar component directly since they're complex gradient SVGs).

Actually: the SVGs are too complex for constants. Keep nav constants as-is, add the 4th "App Development" service and "Help Center" resource. The icons are inlined in the navbar component.

### 2. `src/types/navigation.ts`
Add `description?: string` field.

### 3. `src/lib/constants/navigation.ts`
- Add description to each Solutions child
- Add App Development (comingSoon)  
- Add Help Center to Resources children

### 4. `src/components/layout/navbar.tsx`
Complete rewrite:
- `"use client"` — needed for dropdown state
- Banner strip: navy bg, full-width, rocket emoji text + "Join Beta" underlined link
- Sticky `<header>` with `position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 999999; background: #fff`
- Nav container: full-width flex, space-between
- Logo: `Group-46895.svg`, width 130px
- Desktop nav: Solutions dropdown (rich card) + plain links + Resources dropdown (simple card)
- Solutions dropdown: hover-triggered, rich card with 4 service items (SVG icons inline) + bottom CTA box
- Resources dropdown: hover-triggered, simple card with Blog + Help Center
- Right: Login (outline) + Schedule Demo (gradient with arrow SVG) + hamburger (black square)
- Mobile hamburger: black 48×48 button with 3 white lines

### 5. `src/components/layout/mobile-nav.tsx`
Complete rewrite:
- Sheet from right (or left, Webflow uses a side drawer)
- Logo at top
- Solutions expandable with all 4 services + descriptions
- Plain links (How It Works, Pricing, Our Work, Our Mission)
- Resources expandable
- Bottom: Login (outline) + Schedule Demo (gradient)

### 6. `src/components/layout/footer.tsx`
Complete rewrite — inline the newsletter form (no longer uses NewsletterSignup component, which is a generic/simplified version; we inline the Webflow layout exactly):
- Footer wrapper: `bg-[#082753]`, `px-[5%]`, `py-[72px]` top + `pb-4` bottom
- Container: max-w-[1280px] auto margins
- Grid: 2 cols `.75fr 1.25fr` with 3rem gap
- Left: newsletter card (dark blue radial gradient bg, border, shadow, sparkle eyebrow, heading with gradient span, email input + CTA button, privacy line)
- Right: logo + socials row + 4-col links grid
- Legal wrapper: centered, copyright pill (`bg-[#113569]`) + India flag

---

## Implementation approach

### Dropdowns
Use CSS-driven hover group pattern (`group/solutions` etc.) — no JS for desktop dropdowns. This matches Webflow's hover approach and avoids hydration issues. The dropdown panel appears on `group-hover:visible group-hover:opacity-100`.

For mobile, use the existing Sheet component with `useState` expand/collapse for Solutions and Resources.

### Gradient "Schedule Demo" button
The Webflow `.btn-primary` uses a CSS background-image with a small arrow SVG (`Group-46729-2.svg`) + linear gradient. We replicate this with:
```
style={{ backgroundImage: "url('/images/webflow/Group-46729-2.svg'), linear-gradient(90deg, #21cfff, #019ae6)", backgroundPosition: "93% center, 0 0", backgroundRepeat: "no-repeat, repeat", backgroundSize: "auto, auto" }}
```
This is the exact Webflow approach.

### Newsletter form
The Webflow form has the submit button absolutely positioned inside the input wrapper (`position: absolute; inset: auto 1.5% auto auto`). We replicate this with `relative` on the container and `absolute right-[1.5%]` on the button.

### Types
`NavItem.description` is added for Solutions items (used in dropdown UI).

### `"use client"` usage
- `navbar.tsx` — needs client: dropdown hover state (could be CSS-only but we need mobile state too), banner dismiss
- `mobile-nav.tsx` — needs client: Sheet open state, expand state
- `footer.tsx` — needs client: newsletter form state (email, submit)

---

## Exact color tokens used
- Navy: `#082753`
- Cyan: `#21cfff`
- Cyan dark: `#019ae6`
- Footer bg: `#082753`
- Footer newsletter border: `#05bafe61` (0.38 opacity)
- Footer newsletter card bg: radial-gradient(circle, `#092854`, `#092955ab`)
- Footer link: `#fffc` (white 80%)
- Footer social bg: `#ffffff0d`
- Footer copyright pill: `#113569`
- Coming soon badge (Solutions): `#1890ff` text, `#e6f7ff` bg, `#91d5ff` border
- Menu text: `#082753`
- Dropdown link hover: `#21cfff12`
- Nav toggle open bg: `#f5f7f8`
- Login button border/text: `#082753`
- Login hover: `bg-[#082753] text-white`

---

## Execution order
1. Update `src/types/navigation.ts` — add `description?`
2. Update `src/lib/constants/navigation.ts` — add descriptions, App Dev, Help Center
3. Write `src/components/layout/navbar.tsx`
4. Write `src/components/layout/mobile-nav.tsx`
5. Write `src/components/layout/footer.tsx`
6. Run `pnpm tsc --noEmit` and `pnpm build` to verify

## Key implementation decisions

**Dropdowns**: CSS-driven hover using Tailwind `group` + `group-hover:visible/opacity-100` — no JS needed for desktop (matches Webflow hover behavior). Mobile uses `useState` accordion inside the Sheet.

**Schedule Demo button**: Uses inline `style` for the `background-image` with the arrow SVG + gradient (`url('/images/webflow/Group-46729-2.svg'), linear-gradient(90deg, #21cfff, #019ae6)`) — the exact Webflow CSS approach. Tailwind can't express layered background-images cleanly.

**Newsletter form**: Email input with the "Get Started" button `position: absolute; right: 1.5%` inside a `relative` wrapper — exact match to Webflow's `button-secondary-small` which is `position: absolute; inset: auto 1.5% auto auto`.

**Footer grid**: `style={{ gridTemplateColumns: ".75fr 1.25fr" }}` for left/right split, since Tailwind doesn't have fractional non-integer grid columns built in.

**Footer links grid**: `style={{ gridTemplateColumns: ".75fr 1.25fr 1fr 1fr" }}` — same reason.

**`"use client"` usage**:
- `navbar.tsx` — needs it for mobile hamburger state
- `mobile-nav.tsx` — needs it for Sheet open state + accordion expand state
- `footer.tsx` — needs it for newsletter form email/submit state

**No `any` types** — all props are explicitly typed.
